Find an operation by task below, browse the grouped reference, or jump to
[all functions and methods](/reference/index.qmd#all-functions-and-methods) if you know a name.
Examples use `import pyfixest as pf`, `fit` for one fitted model, and `models`
for a collection of fits.

| I want to | Start here |
| --- | --- |
| Fit OLS, IV, Poisson, a GLM, or quantile regression | [Choose an estimator](/reference-guide/fitted-results.qmd#choose-an-estimator) |

| Inspect coefficients, sample information, or fit statistics | [Working with fitted results](/reference-guide/fitted-results.qmd) |
| Cluster standard errors or configure small-sample corrections | [`vcov()`](/reference/estimation.models.feols_.Feols.vcov.qmd); [`ssc()`](/reference/utils.utils.ssc.qmd) |
| Check which models support a method | [Model support](/reference-guide/model-support.qmd) |
| Predict outcomes or recover fixed effects | [`fit.predict()`](/reference/estimation.models.feols_.Feols.predict.qmd); [`fit.fixef()`](/reference/estimation.models.feols_.Feols.fixef.qmd) |
| Compare specifications or save a plot | [Tables and plots](/reference-guide/fitted-results.qmd#tables-and-plots) |
| Estimate or plot a difference-in-differences design | [DiD tutorial](/tutorials/difference-in-differences.qmd); [`panelview()`](/reference/did.visualize.panelview.qmd) |
| Decompose a coefficient difference | [Decomposition guide](/how-to/regression_decomposition.qmd); [`fit.decompose()`](/reference/estimation.models.feols_.Feols.decompose.qmd) |
| Monitor evidence sequentially | [Anytime-valid inference](/how-to/anytime-valid-inference.qmd) |
| Choose a backend or retain less model data | [Demeaner guide](/how-to/demeaner-backends.qmd); [storage options](/reference-guide/model-storage.qmd) |
| Find example data or understand an error | [Dataset chooser](/reference-guide/example-data.qmd); [errors and remedies](/reference-guide/errors.qmd) |
